name: Chaptershift
original_description: Chaptershift is where writers plan and write their novel: the premise, the characters and places of the story, the timeline, the scenes, and the prose of every chapter. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your Chaptershift book projects. You can ask it to read what your story already holds and build on it, create and update characters, locations and scenes, save the prose you write together into a scene, generate a character portrait, a location picture or a cover, and download your manuscript. Everything you change here appears in Chaptershift, and everything you write in Chaptershift is available here. You sign in with your Chaptershift account.
